$description: product: market. Mizan Market — grocery and everyday commerce, browsed on a sofa, comfortable density. This dimension is applied second, after theme, and it changes exactly three tokens. action.primary and its hover are the simple case: they depend on product alone, take the same value in both themes, and can therefore name a primitive outright. text.secondary is the cross-dimension case: its value depends on the theme as well, which this file cannot see, so it selects a slot instead of naming a value. The slot was already set by whichever theme file ran first — neutral.700 in light, neutral.400 in dark — and aliases resolve after every override is applied, so the selection lands on the right value in both. Market takes the heavier step of the two: it is read at leisure, so it can afford the contrast Move spends on glanceability.
